resources.string: Choose a HY-MT2 GGUF file (Q4_K_M recommended). Translation runs on this device and requires 64-bit Android 6.0 or later. The model is stored separately from the app.

Translation sends text to this service

Source text and discussion context, including author names, are sent to the configured service. Translating an entire thread may incur API charges. API settings and credentials are excluded from app backups.

Source text is sent to the configured service. This interface does not receive discussion context. Translating an entire thread may incur API charges. API settings and credentials are excluded from app backups.
Include the API version path, for example https://api.openai.com/v1. The operation path is appended automatically. HTTPS only; no query parameters or credentials in the URL.
Enter the complete v2 endpoint, for example https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2. HTTPS only; no query parameters or credentials in the URL.
Enter the service API key. Leave empty only for Chat Completions or Responses endpoints that do not require authentication.
Google Advanced requires a valid OAuth access token, not an API key or service-account JSON. Replace the token when it expires; this app does not refresh it automatically.
Enter a model ID supported by your endpoint. For Gemini, omit the models/ prefix.
Optional full model resource, for example projects/PROJECT/locations/global/models/general/nmt. Leave empty to use the Google service default.
Use max_tokens for compatible services that support it, or max_completion_tokens for OpenAI models that require it. No automatic parameter substitution.
Enter the Azure resource region when required by your subscription, for example eastasia. Global single-service resources may leave it empty.
Use default, more, less, prefer_more or prefer_less. Strict more/less requires a language and model supporting formality.
Use the value required by your service. Optional fields can be left empty.
